extDescription.message: Loads add-on features from your Symcon into the visualization, for example notifications on every page.

optIntro.message: The extension loads add-on features from your Symcon into the visualization. Your Symcon needs the module "Visu Extension" for this.

optStep1.message: In Symcon, create an instance "Visu Extension" and press "Add device" in its form.

optStep2.message: Enter the address you open the visualization with, and the code shown there.

optStep3.message: Allow access to this server and reload the visualization.

optEmpty.message: Not connected to any Symcon yet.

optReload.message: Reload the visualization after a change.

optTrust.message: Only connect your own Symcon: the code of the modules docked there runs in your visualization. The key of this browser stays stored here and is not synced. In Symcon you can block or remove the browser at any time.

stDenied.message: Symcon no longer knows this browser or has blocked it. Remove it and connect again.

stInvalid.message: The server does not answer like a Visu Extension of this version. Update the module and the extension.

stForeign.message: Rejected: Symcon names a script that is not on this server under /hook/.

errAddress.message: This is not a valid address. Enter the address you open the visualization with, for example http://symcon.local:3777

errDuplicate.message: This browser is already connected to this server. Remove the connection to pair again.

errPermission.message: Without access to this server the extension cannot load anything there.

errPairDenied.message: The code is wrong or has expired. Press "Add device" in the form of the Visu Extension and enter the new code.

errPairMissing.message: No module "Visu Extension" answers on this server. Is it installed and is there an instance?
